The '''New Republic Embassy''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] embassy built in [[Drepplin]], the capital city of the neutral [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glova]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] was [[Robet Makina]].
